durationNote: Browser time between the start and end of attempts where both are known. This differs from server processing time and excludes pending attempts.
durationUnavailable: This response has no duration measurements.
unmeasuredDurationNote: Completions without a stored duration, including those from before duration measurement was introduced, are excluded from the distribution and shares.
durationAllUnmeasured: Completion records exist, but their duration is unmeasured.
noMeasuredDuration: No completed attempts have a duration to show.
workflowLoadError: Could not load this workflow. Other workflows are still available.
noFailureEvent: This workflow has no failure event.
failureReasonNotConfigured: To aggregate failure reasons, select an enum property on the failure event in Settings and publish a new version.
failureReasonsUnavailable: This response has no failure-reason measurements.
noConfirmedFailures: There are no confirmed failures to show failure reasons for.
failureReasonUnmeasured: Failure records exist, but their reasons are unmeasured.
failureReasonNote: The first failure reason for attempts where both the start and failure are known. Shares use all confirmed failures, including missing and unmeasured reasons.
failureReasonMeta: Property {property} · measured {measured} · missing reason {missing} · unmeasured failures {unmeasured}
failureReasonUnmeasuredNote: Some failures have no stored reason, including failures from before this measurement was introduced. The table's shares may total less than 100% by the unmeasured count.
reasonComparisonNotConfigured: No failure-reason property is configured, so reason-level comparison is hidden.
reasonComparisonUnavailable: One period has no failure-reason measurements, so reason changes cannot be compared.
reasonComparisonIncomplete: Unmeasured failures remain, so reason change comparison is withheld. Reason counts and shares cover only observed failures.
reasonComparisonNoFailures: One period has no confirmed failures, so reason share differences cannot be calculated.
failureReasonPeriodComparison: Failure reason comparison with the previous period
loadingPreviousFailureReasons: Loading failure reasons for the previous period.
previousFailureReasonsUnavailable: The previous period could not be loaded, so failure reasons cannot be compared. Use retry comparison above.
failureRateNote: Overall failure rate is confirmed failures divided by started attempts. A higher reason share does not by itself mean overall failures increased. Pending attempts may later be confirmed as failures.
failureRateComparison: Overall failure rate comparison with the previous period
provisionalFailureComparison: A start-date cohort is still aggregating. The counts, rates and differences shown now may change.
failureReasonComparisonTable: Failure reason comparison with the previous period
failureReasonComparisonNote: Reason shares use all confirmed failures in each period. Share differences (%p) are calculated only when both periods measured reasons. Missing information remains —.
workflowPropertyHelp: Each value is successful attempts divided by started attempts. When comparison is on, matching property values are compared across periods.
